'''2009 Match Play Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 3–4 January 2009, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Premiere - Original VS16]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDFs ([[:File:2009 Match Play Championship Day 1.pdf]], [[:File:2009 Match Play Championship Day 2.pdf]]).

On 15 October 2008 [[Scott Lingrell]] announced that, after talks with the players in charge of the Match Play Championship, two separate events would be run: MPC 2009 on 3–4 January 2009 in Open constructed format, and a Players Championship in March 2009 in Worlds 2000 format. The top 4 of each would meet in an eight-player event at Origins or Gen Con.<ref name="pcf-23548-341470">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=341470#341470 Player's Championship - March 2008, Worlds 2000 Format], Scott Lingrell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (15 October 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081021233924/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=342143&sid=198be8cdf7bda3b05cc740ccf203ad9f Internet Archive]</ref> On 20 October 2008 Lingrell wrote that the tournament director had not yet been named.<ref name="pcf-22043-342689">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=342689#342689 Match Play Championships - 1/3 - 1/4, 2009.], Scott Lingrell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 October 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081021233951/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=342714&sid=198be8cdf7bda3b05cc740ccf203ad9f Internet Archive]</ref> All events were to be held at the Holiday Inn in Cherry Hill, New Jersey; Lingrell did not take a block of rooms, because the hotel's web deals offered the same price.<ref name="pcf-23352-338456">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=338456#338456 Hotel Information], Scott Lingrell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (30 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081201191120/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=338456&sid=cf267b31e64f04c5a0f5a2eee27ef5e7 Internet Archive]</ref> On 30 August 2008, answering a suggestion by [[James Booker]], Lingrell had agreed that the World Champion would be the #1 seed.<ref name="pcf-22721-329434">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=329434#329434 #1 seed], James Booker, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (21 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080913050409/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=332582&sid=49360ecb005b2a8b076275625efc78a5 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-22721-332543">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=332543#332543 #1 seed], Scott Lingrell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (30 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080913050409/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=332582&sid=49360ecb005b2a8b076275625efc78a5 Internet Archive]</ref> In December 2008 Lingrell kept the preregistration list and expected the event to pass the previous year's turnout, which he recalled as 44.<ref name="pcf-22347-357623">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=357623#357623 Preregistration List - 38], Scott Lingrell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (6 December 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081207045353/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=357261&sid=da800f192a94d4e0badb0ea8628c4ff7 Internet Archive]</ref> For first-round byes, players worked out that with between 32 and 64 entrants, (number of players − 32) × 2 would play in round 1 and the rest would have byes, leaving 32 players for round 2.<ref name="pcf-22347-357663">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=357663#357663 Preregistration List - 38], Joe Olson, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (6 December 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081207045353/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=357261&sid=da800f192a94d4e0badb0ea8628c4ff7 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Site:''' Holiday Inn, 2175 West Marlton Pike, Cherry Hill, New Jersey<ref name="pcf-23352-338456" />
* '''Dates:''' 3–4 January 2009
* '''Winner:''' —
